name: NecroOps Local Fixture Specification
description: Requirements for a local, in-memory demonstration of modeled inventory analysis, fixture-specific code examples, and a deterministic numerical safety gate. It is not an AWS integration specification in operation.

safetyInvariants.description: The local legacy fee rule and local example fee rule return identical integer-cent results for accepted fixture amounts.
For accepted fixture amounts, net cents plus fee cents equals gross cents.

A sequential rerun using the latest reconstructed local browser session returns ALREADY_EXORCISED without a second receipt. This local stateless demo does not claim transactional coordination for simultaneous duplicate HTTP submissions, and an earlier still-valid cookie can replay its earlier local snapshot until expiry.

verificationNote: This asset is checked for presence and structure by the Node suite. Kiro spec execution requires separate evidence.
